newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shekou Port Service to take China Anda.
newsitem.headline: Shekou Port Service to take China Anda.

text.p: China Merchants Bureau Shekou Industrial Zone will sell its 37.9 percent stake in Shenzhen Shekou Anda Industry Co Ltd to China Merchants Shekou Port Service Holdings Co Ltd, an Anda spokesman said on Monday.
The spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that Anda, a marine and land transport company, lost 11.18 million yuan 1995 and regisrtered a further loss in 1996.
The Anda official said financial confusion and poor managerment were the main factors behind its losses in 1996. The precise loss figures would not be released until an audit is completed.
He said Shekou Port Service will take control of 31.86 million Anda shares, but did not give the price at which the shares changed hands.

Shekou Industrial Zone is Shekou Port Service's major shareholder, holding 109.7 million legal person shares, accounting for 39.58 percent of Shekou Port's 277.2 million outstanding shares at the end of June 1996, according to Shekou Port Service's 1996 interim report.
An official at Shekou Port Service, a port facility operator, confirmed the plan.
The official said the plan is being drafted by Shekou Industry Zone, which expected Anda and Shekou Port Service to both benefit from the deal. He declined to elaborate.
